insights.one_liner: US customer-relationship software giant with an Amsterdam office; mostly senior sales roles, most of them open to English speakers.

culture.text: Calls itself the number-one AI CRM and its staff 'Trailblazers'.
All 5 roles here are in Amsterdam, mostly sales and account management at mid or senior level.

open.text: 80% of its 5 jobs here don't need Dutch.
Not found as an IND recognised sponsor under this name.

growth.text: Staff grew from 13,300 in 2014 to 35,000 in 2019; 2024 revenue was USD 37.895 billion with USD 6.197 billion net profit.
Set a revenue target of over USD 63 billion for fiscal 2030.
Signed an agreement to acquire AI research platform Listen Labs.

worth_knowing.text: Researchers found zero-click flaws in its Agentforce AI agents that allowed CRM data theft.
